g.text: One temperature per primitive is fitted across two regimes

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Every model stores its raw log-scores, so both recipes are fitted on the same validation predictions and scored on the same test records -- no re-inference.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The slope is kept only where it cuts validation NLL by at least 1%, so a model whose miscalibration does not depend on the option count keeps exactly its old

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e
